mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate signals an overheating economy, triggering a monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when the interaction (FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling) occurs in more than 40% of cases without negative 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime characterized by rising residential construction (HOUST) and strong consumer spending (RSAFS), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 650000, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5%, it indicates a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed may tighten policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings growth and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: The positive return signal fails when both HOUST and RSAFS rise in more than 45% of cases without positive 20-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in residential construction (HOUST) indicates strong housing market activity, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive return signal fails when HOUST rises in more than 50% of cases without positive 60-day returns.
